howto.title: How to play
howto.intro: Guess the car of the day: its make, model and year.
howto.rule1: You have five chances to nail it.
howto.rule2: Each wrong guess shows a bit more of the car.
howto.rule3: Green = correct, red = wrong. The year arrow shows if the real one is higher or lower; the flag means you got the country.
howto.rule4: It counts as correct within ±2 years.
howto.rule5: Come back every 24h for a new car and keep your streak.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: Your account closes and everything that identifies you is erased. There's no going back.
deleteAccount.goneBody: Your name, your email and the Google sign-in. Your player name, so you leave the leaderboard, the Hall of Champions and public profiles. And the daily reminders.
deleteAccount.staysBody: The record of your games, now anonymous. Closed months and seasons are ranked from it: if it vanished, other players' podiums would change.
deleteAccount.irreversible: This can't be undone and the account can't be recovered.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: Last stop. Confirm and your account is deleted right now, and you're signed out on this device.
deleteAccount.errorRateLimited: Too many tries in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.
deleteAccount.errorGeneric: Couldn't delete the account. Please try again in a moment.

garage.repescaRuleHalfPoints: Score counts half of a normal game.
garage.repescaHelpBody: Rescue is a daily second chance to catch up on past cars of the day you haven't guessed yet.
garage.repescaHelpSurpriseDesc: Picked at random from your pending cars. You won't see make, model or country until the game starts.
garage.repescaHelpOnceDesc: You can only play one rescue every 24 hours. If you miss, you'll have to wait until tomorrow.
garage.repescaHelpHalfDesc: Whatever you score on a rescue counts half compared to a normal game.
garage.repescaHelpNoStreakDesc: Win or lose, your daily streak stays untouched.
garage.repescaHelpVeteranDesc: If the random pick lands on a car you already saw when you failed it, the rescue gets harder: 1 attempt and no hints. You'll need to remember exact make, model and year. Win it and the cover gets stamped with a badge.
garage.authBody: Sign in to file your wins as numbered covers, complete countries and save your progress.

garage.emptyBody: Every car you guess is filed here as a numbered cover, with its date and the attempts it took you.
